description: This file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_Internal_CompileBase' which provides methods for compiling Smarty template tags, including attribute validation, tag stack management, and error handling. It appears to be part of the internal compiler plugin system of Smarty, a PHP templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_CompileBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing core compilation functionality for Smarty internal template plugins, including attribute validation and tag stack management.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Validates and processes the attributes passed to a Smarty template tag, ensuring required attributes are present and optional attributes are valid; returns a normalized array of attributes.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Pushes the opening tag name and associated data onto the compiler's tag stack.

methods.name: closeTag
methods.description: Pops the last opened tag from the stack, verifies nesting correctness, and returns the tag name or associated data, or triggers an error if mismatched.
